findings.title: Punishment pictured in the open
findings.claim: Within the pericope's movement from the raised sky to the spread earth, the focus's named punishment also forms an image of exposure: it is encountered as something standing uncovered beneath the overhead and opposite the lower ground.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun عَذَابَ is mapped to the exact exposed-to-sky facet, while 88:18 supplies the overhead sky and 88:20 supplies the lower ground. Their contact activates the upper/lower relation that the branch requires, so the focus punishment is newly read through an exposure scene rather than as a context-free label.
findings.reader_payoff: The sanction becomes spatially perceptible as openness to what is above and a lower surface beneath it, while the ordinary punitive event remains visible.
findings.containment: The ordinary meaning of ağır acı çektirme and cezalandırma remains intact. This does not assert a literal outdoor location, general nudity, or a new punishment mechanism; the 88:17 and 88:19 counter-evidence supplies no separate trigger, so the image is bounded to the supplied sky-earth relation.

epistemic.reason: Trusted branch nominations, exact context ayah text, and reciprocal sky/earth connections support the activation, but the context projection supplies no word-level morphology for 88:18 or 88:20, so those carriers remain ayah-level contextual evidence.

findings.title: Authority returns to its proper holder
findings.claim: The focus closes the pericope's movement by assigning the acts to separate agents: the human role is reminder, coercive control is set aside, refusal belongs to the one who turns and covers, and Allah is the agent of punishment before return and accounting are placed on the divine side.
findings.mechanism: The supplied HFT trace links the reminder function in 88:21 to the negated control in 88:22, the refusal and concealment in 88:23, the explicit divine subject and punishment in 88:24, and the return and accounting in 88:25-26. The focus therefore changes the preceding threat from a possible mandate to compel into a traced division of jurisdiction.
findings.reader_payoff: The sequence becomes a visible allocation of responsibility: reminder, refusal, punishment, return, and account each have a stated place, with the focus clause serving as the turn to divine agency.
findings.containment: The HFT before-reading, that the threat could intensify the preceding address into a mandate to compel, remains a live alternative to the attributed after-reading. The exact syntactic reach of the exception in 88:23 is unresolved. This finding does not establish an oath/expiation cycle, a broader doctrine of authority, or any unregistered lexical facet; seven branch activations remain attributed because their independent lexicon records are absent.
